actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent molecular identity defined by strong, FDR-significant PBRM1 mutation enrichment (OR 8.57, 95% CI 3.14-23.42, BH-q 0.00033) with supportive RNA upregulation of cholesterol homeostasis (SMD 0.823, q 0.0162). This is a meaningful, biologically interpretable identity rather than an isolated favorable observation. Current membership is structurally compatible: no set-specific technical confounder is significant for C0001 (all per-set confounder q=1.0), and the global manufacturer association is a general partition limitation not specifically aligned with this set. Cross-modal silhouettes are weak, but weak structural cohesion alone does not justify Drop, and no positively supported Split or Merge is available. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent identity defined by FDR-significant RNA downregulation of adipogenesis and fatty-acid metabolism-related pathways (SMD -0.777 and -0.769, both BH-q 0.0484), with concordant directional trends in WXS (BAP1-absent, PBRM1-depleted) and CNV (chr3p loss lower). The RNA program is concentrated in a plausible metabolic theme rather than scattered features. No set-specific technical confounder is significant for C0002, and the global manufacturer association is a general limitation. Structural support is weak but not actively contradictory, and no better-supported Split or Merge exists. Retaining C0002 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0003 has a coherent RNA-defined identity with the largest number of FDR-significant pathways (9 of 50), including large-magnitude upregulation of pancreas beta cells (SMD 1.031, q 0.0084) and TGF-beta signaling, plus FDR-significant CNV features (chr12p and chr16p lower, q 0.0275). Cross-modal structure is moderately supportive (positive WSI, RNA, and CNV silhouettes; median patient support 3). Although C0003 shows set-specific technical associations with CT manufacturer, tissue source site, and reconstruction kernel (q 0.019), these are CT-acquisition factors and the defining identity is molecular (RNA and CNV), so the measured technical factors do not plausibly dominate the molecular signal. No positively supported Split or Merge is available. Retaining C0003 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0004 has a strong, coherent identity defined by FDR-significant BAP1 mutation enrichment (OR 77.0, 95% CI 13.8-429.7, BH-q 9.4e-08) with PBRM1 depletion (q 0.0251) and concordant upregulation of immune/inflammatory RNA pathways (allograft rejection SMD 1.012, interferon alpha SMD 0.955, 9 of 50 pathways significant). This is a biologically interpretable, cross-modally coherent program (positive RNA and WXS silhouettes, WXS notably higher). No set-specific technical confounder is significant for C0004. No positively supported Split or Merge is available. Retaining C0004 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0005 has a coherent identity defined by strong, FDR-significant depletion of VHL (OR 0.032, BH-q 6.3e-05) and PBRM1 (q 0.0136) mutations, with a significant chr21q loss (OR 42.0, q 0.0127). This VHL/PBRM1-depleted, chr21q-loss profile is a meaningful molecular identity, and WXS provides the strongest single-modality structural support (silhouette 0.140). RNA pathways are not FDR-significant, but absence of RNA significance with limited power is not active contradiction. No set-specific technical confounder is confirmed for C0005 (trends q 0.12-0.17 are exploratory), and no positively supported Split or Merge exists. Retaining C0005 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
